name: cruise-ground
pre: for (let i = 0; i < 1200 && v.groundDetail.pending; i++) await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const k = v.groundDetail.shown; v.__outCur = k ? v.groundDetail.variants.get(k).material : v.outsideMat; v.__outCur.uniforms.uHaze = v.atmosphere.hazeUniforms.uHaze; v.__outCur.uniforms.uHazeShape = v.atmosphere.hazeUniforms.uHazeShape; return 'haze=' + v.atmosphere.hazeUniforms.uHaze.value.toArray().map((x) => x.toFixed(3)) + ' shown=' + JSON.stringify(k);
